identity.name: King Seiko KSK
identity.one_liner: A numbered 3,000-piece recreation of King Seiko's 1965 reference 44-9990, reviving the King Seiko name as a modern limited edition.

narrative.story: The SJE083 recreates King Seiko's 1965 reference 44-9990, nicknamed KSK, as a numbered limited edition of 3,000 pieces. It runs caliber 6L35, a 26-jewel automatic with hacking seconds and roughly 45 hours of reserve, in a 38.1mm case with a super-hard coating and a silvered sunburst dial with a textured pyramid pattern at 12 o'clock. It belongs to the King Seiko name's 2020 revival as a modern reissue line, sitting above the more widely available SPB27x-series King Seiko references.
narrative.collector_notes: Individually numbered out of 3,000 pieces; check that the printed number on the caseback matches any accompanying certificate before buying used.
